main.description: Returns the indexed like and repost for each supplied subject occurrence by one actor. Authentication is not required. Subject matching ignores CID; duplicate inputs and request order are preserved. For each reaction collection, duplicate actor and subject URI pairs use the earliest valid createdAt; when it is absent or invalid, ordering falls back to indexedAt and then the database row's created_at timestamp, with reaction URI ascending on ties. A missing indexed reaction is null; query failures return an error.

actor.description: Repository-owner DID of the actor whose reactions to look up.

subjects.description: One or more full record AT-URIs with DID authorities, not handle authorities, supplied as repeated unbracketed query values. Results preserve each occurrence and its input order.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID, subjects array, subject AT-URI, or another query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ActorReactionsQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed actor reactions could not be queried or returned a malformed result; retry the request.

results.description: One result for each supplied subject occurrence, in request order, including duplicates.

subject.description: The subject AT-URI from this request occurrence; matching ignores CID.

like.description: The actor's earliest indexed like for this subject URI, or null when none is indexed.

repost.description: The actor's earliest indexed repost for this subject URI, or null when none is indexed.
